name: Leila Fontaine
notes: Skills presented as a vertical bulleted list in a left sidebar column alongside the work experience. The two-column layout means skills and experience text are interleaved in raw extraction order.

sections.heading: SUMMARY
items: Versatile content writer and copywriter with 6+ years producing high-performing content across brand, digital, and editorial channels. Equally comfortable crafting long-form thought leadership and punchy ad copy. Known for fast turnaround, strong editorial instincts, and an ability to adapt tone and voice across wildly different industries and audiences.

items.title: Senior Copywriter
items.subtitle: Ember Creative Agency, Austin, TX
bullets: Leads copy across a portfolio of 8 active client accounts spanning SaaS, fintech, and consumer lifestyle brands, owning everything from brand messaging frameworks to individual campaign assets.
Developed a full content strategy and editorial calendar for a B2B SaaS client that grew organic blog traffic by 140% over 12 months.
Mentors two junior copywriters and conducts weekly copy reviews to maintain consistent quality and brand voice standards across the team.

items.title: Content Writer
items.subtitle: Driftwood Media Group, Dallas, TX
bullets: Produced 10+ pieces of content per week across SEO blogs, email sequences, and paid social copy for clients in healthcare, real estate, and education sectors.
Consistently ranked among the top three performers for client satisfaction scores across the agency's writer pool.
Rewrote the onboarding email sequence for a real estate tech client, increasing open rates by 28% and click-through rates by 19%.

items.title: Freelance Copywriter
items.subtitle: Self-Employed
bullets: Served a roster of 12 small business and startup clients, delivering brand naming, taglines, website copy, and launch campaign content.
Developed brand voice guides for 4 clients from scratch, establishing tone, vocabulary, and messaging pillars still in use today.

items.title: Content Strategist (Contract)
items.subtitle: Verve Publishing Group, Austin, TX
bullets: Embedded with the editorial team to support a digital content overhaul across three online publications covering technology, culture, and lifestyle.
Audited 500+ existing articles for SEO performance and rewrote underperforming pieces, contributing to a 35% increase in organic search visibility over six months.
Collaborated with editors and designers to develop a refreshed content style guide adopted site-wide across all three publications.
